description: This source file provides implementations for stream namespace predicate providers within the Orleans streaming framework, including a default provider and a constructor-based provider, along with related utility methods.

classes.name: DefaultStreamNamespacePredicateProvider
classes.description: Provides default streaming namespace predicates, such as wildcard, regex, and exact match predicates.

classes.name: ConstructorStreamNamespacePredicateProvider
classes.description: Provides stream namespace predicates based on constructing predicate objects, supporting type and optional argument.

methods.name: TryGetPredicate
methods.description: Attempts to parse a predicate pattern string into an `IStreamNamespacePredicate` instance, returning true if successful.

methods.name: FormatPattern
methods.description: Generates a predicate pattern string for a given predicate type and optional constructor argument.
